responsibility: Declares the compilers for impl-associated items. It provides a proxy wrapper that routes inherent impl items through the normal item compiler and a dedicated trait-item compiler for associated constants and methods with a concrete TyTy instantiation, giving path and trait-resolution code a uniform query interface for impl and trait members.
same_name_distinction: Declares the impl-item compilation front ends: a proxy class that routes inherent impl items through normal item compilation and a dedicated trait-item visitor interface for associated constants and methods. Unlike the .cc file, it does not compile any specific impl item bodies or perform monomorphized lookup/reuse logic.
